auth.title: Authentication smoke
auth.why: Verify that login flows are reachable and credentials are accepted before running broader suites.

smoke.title: Core smoke
smoke.why: Run a minimal health-check pack for fast validation on any environment.

homepage.title: Homepage interactions
homepage.why: Verify sorting and resource type filters work correctly on the homepage grid.

maps.title: Maps CRUD
maps.why: Verify that an admin can create and delete a map end-to-end.

map-permissions.title: Map permissions
map-permissions.why: Verify view and edit permissions on maps for groups, IP ranges, standard users and anonymous visitors, and unadvertised maps.

ldap.title: LDAP authentication
ldap.why: Verify that a standard LDAP user can authenticate when LDAP profile is enabled.

geoserver.title: GeoServer catalog integration
geoserver.why: Verify that a layer can be added to a map from the catalog when GeoServer profile is enabled.

catalog.title: Catalog services
catalog.why: Verify WFS and CSW catalog searches on the local GeoServer.

map-toc.title: Map table of contents
map-toc.why: Verify layer visibility, settings, attribute table, removal and filtering in the map viewer.

map-tools.title: Map tools
map-tools.why: Verify zoom controls, zoom to layer extent, projection readout and persistence of viewer changes.

map-services.title: Map backgrounds, search and 3D
map-services.why: Verify the background selector, place search and the 3D viewer on services of the local GeoServer.

print.title: Printing
print.why: Verify that a map with a GeoServer layer is printed to PDF by the printing module.

dashboard.title: Dashboards
dashboard.why: Verify dashboard creation, text widgets and data widgets built on the local GeoServer layer.

geostory.title: GeoStories
geostory.why: Verify geostory creation, edit mode and section authoring.

context.title: Application contexts
context.why: Verify the context creator wizard, opening a created context and removing it.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.why: Verify the user manager lists accounts and that a created user can authenticate.

url-params.title: Opening MapStore from a link
url-params.why: Verify that the map view passed in the URL or posted by an external page through setParams is applied.

dashboard-views.title: Dashboard views
dashboard-views.why: Verify the layout views of a dashboard: naming, adding, ordering, removal and read only display.

resource-permissions.title: Dashboard and story permissions
resource-permissions.why: Verify view, edit and IP range permissions of dashboards and geostories, and the tools of their viewers.
